defs.def: a substance that consists of very small fine grains of rock. Sand is found on beaches, in deserts, etc. 沙

ex.s: Though Smith did get her hands on the best sand, doing things the old-fashioned way isn't just about playing around with French mud.
ex.t: 这项工作也为博物馆带来了启示，史密斯说。

ex.s: Many people think that positive thinking is mostly about keeping one's head in the sand and ignoring daily problems, trying to look optimistic.
ex.t: 许多人认为积极思维主要是把头埋在沙子里，忽略日常问题，试图表现得乐观。

ex.s: It sounds like I will be sailing on a(n) 4_____ of sand!
ex.t: 听起来我将在4_____的沙子上航行！

ex.s: We were walking on fine, even sand, not wrinkled, as on a flat shore, which keeps the impression of the waves.
ex.t: 我们走在细腻平整的沙子上，没有褶皱，就像在平坦的海岸上，保留着海浪的印痕。

ex.s: How much time do you spend on “rocks”, “pebbles”, “sand” and “tea”?
ex.t: 你花在"石头"、"鹅卵石"、"沙子"和"茶"上的时间各有多少？

ex.s: Sand now filled the wells instead of water.
ex.t: 水井里现在填满的是沙子而不是水。

ex.s: How many seas must a whi(te) dove sail Before she sleeps in the sand?
ex.t: 一只白鸽要飞越多少片海 才能在沙滩上安睡？

defs.def: a large area of sand on a beach 沙滩
